notes: Biggest limitation: four of six fullpage captures (B1,B3,B5,B6) contain very large flat empty bands - B6 ~9000px pure black, B5 ~8000px flat cream, B3 ~5800px black. These are the signature of a pinned/fixed canvas that does not paint into a stitched fullpage screenshot, not necessarily dead page regions, so I did not treat them as ordinary layout defects; listed each but flagged as ambiguous. This cuts both ways: B5 and B3 each gave a second independent data point corroborating their systems; B6 gave none - its desktop viewport and mobile shot are both at scroll zero - so everything below B6's hero is unassessed, and I scored its continuity on hero evidence alone rather than inflating on the strength of its chapter names. B6 is the one build I could not fairly assess in full. Dimension 2 excluded as instructed and not substituted for: several builds show interactive affordances whose actual responsiveness is invisible in stills, and I credited only composition, not claimed behaviour. B4's empty motion.css/motion.js panels are the one case where I cannot tell whether content failed to render or is populated only on interaction; scored as a visible defect because the section reads as broken as captured.
